info.title: Datix API
info.description: Cookie-authenticated website management and reports; public, origin-validated event collection. Reports are eventually consistent with queue processing. Visitor counts are estimates scoped to an environment and UTC day.

get.description: Public language and theme preferences. Saved cookies take precedence over trusted country defaults; responses are not cached.
Public tracking switches only. The tracker refreshes these after 60 seconds. No account or billing data is returned.

settings.description: Per-environment switches. Omitted persisted keys default to true. When updating, send every switch as a boolean.

get.description: Account-wide event allowance, monthly renewal window and per-website collection status. Requires an active subscription or trial to collect. Production pageviews use 1 credit, actions use 0.5; localhost multiplies these by 0.3. Engagement heartbeats and duplicate deliveries are free.

eventLimit.description: Customer-specific Polar grant allowance; null means unlimited.

websiteLimit.description: Customer-specific Polar grant allowance; null means unlimited.

remaining.description: Granted credits less committed local usage; null means unlimited.

onboardingCompleted.description: Persisted completion of initial website setup. Does not itself grant subscription access.

get.summary: Read private service and account status
get.description: Requires a signed session whose normalized email is configured in ADMIN_EMAILS. Redis failures return a degraded status instead of hiding database and account counts.

200.description: Current service, dependency, queue, and account counts

get.description: Detailed session data is limited to 30 days. Lists 50 sessions per page with summary session/visitor/click counts and average active seconds, or 200 activities for a session key. Use hasMore and nextCursor for stable keyset pagination; nextOffset remains available for older clients. Report responses may be cached for up to five seconds. Heartbeats contribute active time but are omitted from event counts and timelines.

post.description: No account cookie. Origin and event URL must agree. Hostname must match the registered domain, or localhost/127.0.0.1/::1 when allowLocalhost is enabled. application/json and text/plain JSON are supported. 8192-byte body limit. Session mode requires session metadata with consent=true; cookieless mode rejects it. The website must obtain analytics consent before sending any session event. A 202 accepted=true confirms a queue write, not ingestion. DNT and detected bots return accepted=false. Spam protection runs before queueing and billing; rejected spam returns reason=spam_detected.

202.description: Queued, excluded by spam or tracking settings, or paused by an account allowance or website budget
